description: This file defines the 'Country' model class in the OpenCart project, responsible for retrieving country-related data from the database, such as fetching country details by ID or ISO codes, and listing all countries.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: A model class for managing international country data retrieval, interactions with the database, and caching within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a country's record from the database by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Fetches country information based on the 2-letter ISO code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Fetches country information based on the 3-letter ISO code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active countries with their descriptions, utilizing caching for performance.
